cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit and supplies its composition, camera, and temporal structure.
Source caption: A tiger is resting on a rock and yawning widely, showing its sharp teeth and tongue.
<Subject 1> is the tiger in <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the rock in <Video 1>.
<Subject 3> is the remaining source scene in <Video 1>.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>.
Replace the tiger with a lion

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - Apply the edit requested in the summary; preserve its other source properties and actions.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve this source object, including its appearance and motion.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve the remaining source scene and objects.
<Video 1> (composition, camera, and temporal structure): fully_preserved - Preserve the source framing, camera motion, cuts, and action timing.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A lion is resting on a rock and yawning widely, showing its sharp teeth and tongue.
The edited subject is <Subject 1>; the source rock is <Subject 2>, and the remaining setting is <Subject 3>, as shown in <Video 1>.

overall_soundscape:
The benchmark specifies no audio edit.

non_diegetic_music:
The benchmark specifies no music edit.
